complete_archive_scope: Deduplicated union of both completed Experiment03 file indexes, the four individual index/manifest files, and the global sync index. Includes common source and all seven new scene GT assets. Paths start with scene-rsi/.
browsable_scope: Source, configuration, prompts, frozen libraries, student workspaces, analysis, reviewer outputs, figures and human review pages. Raw bridge/proxy/capture streams, mirrored inputs and files over 10 MiB are retained in the complete Release archive. New GT .blend files are also in the Release archive.
reused_ground_truth: Three original development GT assets and Experiment01/02 records remain in the existing repository and Experiment02 Release.
publication_only_changes: README navigation and download instructions; existing publication .gitignore retained. Original scientific files and historical indexes are preserved in the complete archive.
excluded: Credentials, protected metadata roots, runtime/backend homes, installed environments, temporary files, bytecode and symlinks.
